name: Scroll of Ember
description: The ink is slightly scorched at the edges. That is either craftsmanship or a warning.
notes: A scroll of Ember (mw-ju8.4), spell.ember. Book kind scroll (mw-e07.1): reading it casts the spell once, free, for any class, and spends the scroll (owner decision 2026-10-24). That runtime is mw-ju8.17; `book.casts` is added with it, once spell content exists (mw-e08), because a spell reference to a missing spell fails the load. Base value 60 sits in the economy scroll band (40-150).
